RemoteCC uses MarkdownUI 2.4.1 (https://github.com/gonzalezreal/swift-markdown-ui), NetworkImage 6.0.1 (https://github.com/gonzalezreal/NetworkImage), and swift-cmark (https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-cmark). Exact revisions are recorded in macos/Package.resolved. Their copyright and license notices are included alongside this file.

The colour palettes, derived-token rules, layout metrics and motion timings of the interface theme are adapted from winc (https://github.com/DEEIX-AI/Winc), Copyright 2026 Chenyme and DEEIX AI, licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (winc-LICENSE.txt). They were modified: the palettes are renamed, translated to AppKit colours and mapped onto this application's surfaces. winc's NOTICE reads: "winc. Copyright 2026 Chenyme and DEEIX AI. This product is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0." The syntax highlighter is an independent implementation that uses the same nine token categories.

Additional Winc-derived interface work: shared controls, workspace top bar, floating settings and dialogs, command palette and paired diff presentation. Layout and interaction patterns were translated from Rust rendering code to SwiftUI/AppKit; SSH and chat behavior remain independently implemented. Reference revision: 3543359546d03fa89b48d1046175176801655dfc.

Workspace glyph geometry and toolbar metrics adapted from Winc v0.1.502 (a8a42da), icons.rs and icons/files.rs, Copyright 2026 Chenyme and DEEIX AI, Apache-2.0. Modified into SwiftUI paths and shared button styles; chat-specific glyphs added in the same stroke style.

Winc preview engine v0.1.502 (a8a42da), Copyright Winc contributors, Apache-2.0.
Unmodified Rust source: vendor/winc-preview/crates/winc-preview and winc-i18n.
Bundled helper WincPreview links this source directly.
